messages:
Marta: Quick preflight/provisioning handoff for today — short async standup. What I did: requested +8 GPUs in us-west1, kicked off prewarm job for rtx-a100 pool, opened quota request for europe-west1. Blockers: pending quota approval in EU (billing owner needed), and one prewarm pod failed to attach NVMe. Today: monitor prewarm, follow up with billing, and if quota delayed will flip traffic to dedicated on-demand fallback. @Sam can you ack the manifest change? :eyes:

Sam: Acked. Saw the manifest diff, added minReplicas=4 to the GPU deployment and fixed the HPA target CPU to tokenizer service. Also restarted the prewarm job once; logs showed OOM on init container. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/PR/342 — small change, should keep autoscaler from shrinking below prewarm pool. :+1:

June: Oncall notes — two spot preemptions in us-west1-b at 03:12 UTC, both recovered to fallback pool automatically. We did see a brief latency spike on the embedder (~600ms p95) for ~2m. Saved traces here: https://otel.redwood/trace/0xabc123. No customer impact reported.

Leo: I filed the quota ticket in GCP (GCP-987654) for europe-west1 GPU quota increase (requesting +12 A100s). ETA 24-48h per support. If we need immediate capacity, we can temporarily move non-prod workloads to us-central1 and shift some reserved nodes. Also FYI bumped reserved pool for us-west1 to include p4d_xlarge.

Marta: Thanks. Quick note on the NVMe attach failure — repro steps below, happened once on prewarm-3: 
```
kubectl describe pod prewarm-3 -n prewarm
# saw attach timeout from kubelet: "error attaching volume: context deadline exceeded"
```
I retried and pod came up. We'll add retry logic to the init container.

Sam: Adding retry to init container now. Also adding a short lived metric to alert if prewarm success rate drops below 80% in 10m window. Alert name: prewarm.success.rate.low.

infra-bot: deploy-job /ops/prewarm-job finished: success (1930456820). Artifacts: prewarm-log-1930456820.txt

Marta: Action items: 1) Leo follow quota ticket and escalate if no response in 12h. 2) Sam merge PR and add alert. 3) June watch oncall slide for any more preemptions overnight. I'll update the provisioning doc after lunch and post the checklist. Ping me for handoff if you want me to stay on for the rollout. :rocket:
